The words देवा and ब्राह्मण in those hymns have अनुदात्त accent.

Terms:

The affix वुञ् comes after the verbs देवि 'to lament' and क्रुश 'to cry' when an उपसर्ग is in composition with them.

Terms: वुञ्
After the words देवपथ etc. there is similar elision of the affix कन् -- इवे प्रतिकृतौ

expressing an image or a Name.

Terms: कन्

After a stem ending in the word देवता being in the Dative -4th Case in construction comes the affix यत् (यं) in the sense of 'appointed for it'.

Terms: यत् (यं)

The affix तल् comes after देव without change of sense.

Terms: तल्

After the words 1. देव 2. मनुष्य 3. पुरुष 4. पुरु and 5. मर्त्ये ending in the Accusative -2nd case or Locative -7th case, the affix त्रा is diversely used, having the force of the Accusative -2nd case or Locative -7th case.

Terms: त्रा

In a द्वन्द compound of the Names of Divinities, both the members retain their original accent.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

The आनङ् is the substitute for the final of the first member in a द्वन्द समास of the names of the देवता-s.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् , the वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowels of both members of द्वन्द समास of the names of देवता-s।

Terms: वृद्धि

When a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् follows, आ is substituted instead of वृद्धि for the first vowels of the following - 1. देविका 2. शिंशपा 3. दित्यवाट् 4. दीर्घसत्र and 5. श्रेयस।

Terms: तद्धित changes

Long आ is substituted for the final of देव and सुम्न before the Denominative क्यच् in यजुष काठक।

Terms: क्यच् affix
